name: cant
description: The Catalog of Agent Neutralization Techniques (CANT) as a plugin. Ships the machine-readable catalog (cant.yaml) plus a skill that wires CANT-tagged behavioral eval cases into skill authoring: identify a skill's promises, map them to named techniques, and generate gate and pressure cases. Works in Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and OpenAI Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Generate CANT-tagged behavioral eval cases for the promises a skill makes
